lineage.core_design: surge-audit custody and calibrated tidal machinery

chapters.title: Retired balance card
chapters.body: A retired balance card lists the Lumen counterweight at forty-two kilograms before the alloy insert was installed.

chapters.title: Acceptance weighing
chapters.body: Talia Quill signed the acceptance weighing: the alloy-fitted Lumen counterweight measured fifty-seven kilograms, replacing the retired figure.

chapters.title: Pre-surge custody
chapters.body: Before the surge alarm, the Driftglass Crate was strapped to rack seven inside Meridian Intake.

chapters.title: Post-surge transfer
chapters.body: The post-surge custody ledger transfers the Driftglass Crate to locker two at Brackwater Gantry and marks Meridian rack seven empty.

chapters.title: Impeller cadence
chapters.body: Iven Rusk timed the north impeller at Meridian Intake: each complete cycle lasted nine minutes.

chapters.title: Reserve valve mark
chapters.body: The reserve sluice valve carries one saffron stripe around its handwheel for night identification.

chapters.title: Vane handover note
chapters.body: The vane handover note is signed only R. S.; the blackout roster lists both Rina Sol and Rook Sable, and no entry resolves which person the initials denote.

chapters.title: Sample route amendment
chapters.body: The sample route amendment names Nacre Pier only after a calibration, but the calibration's effective time is unrecorded and the surge log does not say whether the amendment then applied.
